feat: add Inkling 2 support (text + vision) (#32217)

* convert : add Inkling2 text GGUF conversion

Assisted-by: Codex

* llama : implement Inkling2 text inference

Assisted-by: Codex

* tests : cover Inkling2 text support

Assisted-by: Codex

* conversion : dequantize packed Inkling2 experts in row chunks

Decode per-layer NVFP4 and MXFP8 schemes, validate companions, and use stored scale shapes with a warning for the declared MXFP8 [32,32] grid. Reorder packed w13 rows and their scale rows together. Keep normal GGUF outtype selection and 3D expert tensors.

Stream 128 rows per expert through LazyChunkedTensor. Real w13 (384x4608x4608) needs a 2.25 MiB F32 chunk instead of a 30.375 GiB expanded layer. Real-shaped sparse probes peak below 5.8 MiB of Python/NumPy chunk allocations, plus 5.2 MiB of callback metadata: budget about 16 MiB per projection including mapped pages, excluding runtime, other tensors and OS cache. Full-model chunk metadata is roughly 370 MiB.

Packed synthetic GGUF weights match the independent pinned vLLM decode bit-for-bit. CPU prefill/decode logits remain within 3.1e-6 absolute error, with 100% argmax agreement. Float fixtures, original-name conversion and CPU architecture checks pass. Real checkpoint conversion remains untested.
